zh-Hans.name: 嘟嘟小店 - 灵动岛宠物餐厅
zh-Hans.subtitle: 它很懒，但会陪你开一家小店
zh-Hans.promo: 嘟嘟星在变暗。它是那里最后一家小店的逃跑小徒弟，现在住进了你的灵动岛。你做菜，它躺着收钱，一单一单把家乡点亮。
zh-Hans.keywords: 桌宠,电子宠物,养成,合成,做菜,经营,模拟,实时活动,锁屏,陪伴,萌宠,换装,治愈,解压,计步
zh-Hans.description:
嘟嘟是一只住在灵动岛里的紫色小宠物。它很懒，手很短，不吵你，只是一直在。

【嘟嘟星在变暗】
嘟嘟星的光，是大家互相做饭点亮的。它家乡最后一家小店关了门——店是它关的。开店第一晚，灵动岛的门缝里递进来一张家乡的小票……

【跟着你变】
你走路、跑步、开车、上班、睡觉，灵动岛里的嘟嘟会换成对应的样子，说一句懒洋洋的话。

【嘟嘟小店】
把食材拖到一起合成、做菜、接订单。急单、熟客的小故事，还有每章一张门那边来的门单。

【打扮它】
20 多件帽子、眼镜、颈饰，戴上以后灵动岛里也看得到。

【布置它的窝】
每个位置都有好几种款式：云朵软垫、水母夜灯、月亮躺椅……慢慢攒，慢慢换。

不用注册，不要账号，没有广告。所有数据都只存在你的手机里。

需要 iPhone 14 Pro 或更新的带灵动岛的机型才能在灵动岛里看到嘟嘟；其他机型在锁屏实时活动里显示。

en-US.name: Dudu Shop: Dynamic Island Pet
en-US.subtitle: A lazy pet who runs a shop
en-US.promo: Planet Dudu is going dark. Its runaway shop apprentice now lives in your Dynamic Island. You cook, it collects coins, and one order at a time, its home lights back up.
en-US.description:
Dudu is a small, round, very lazy purple pet who lives in your Dynamic Island. Short arms. Always lying down. Never nags — just stays with you.

PLANET DUDU IS GOING DARK
On Planet Dudu, light comes from cooking for each other. Its last little shop closed — and Dudu is the one who closed it. On your first night open, a ticket from home drifts down through the crack in the Dynamic Island…

IT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
Walk, run, drive, work or sleep, and Dudu in the Dynamic Island changes with you, with a sleepy little line.

DUDU SHOP
Drag matching ingredients together to merge them, cook, and fill orders. Rush orders, regulars with their own little stories, and a door order from Planet Dudu every chapter.

DRESS IT UP
20+ hats, glasses and neckwear — and you can see them in the Dynamic Island too.

DECORATE ITS NEST
Every spot has several styles: a cloud cushion, a jellyfish night light, a moon lounger… collect them slowly.

No sign-up, no account, no ads. Everything stays on your phone.

The Dynamic Island needs iPhone 14 Pro or later; on other models Dudu lives on the Lock Screen.

review_notes:
Dudu Shop (嘟嘟小店) is a merge-cooking game with a virtual pet, Dudu, that lives in the Dynamic Island and Live Activity. Chinese and English (follows the system language). No account or login is required.

About the previous rejection (Guideline 5.6): build 1.0.0 (128) contained an internal developer test panel (tap the level number 7 times) that we used to jump chapters while testing. It was never meant for players and should not have been in the build. It has been completely removed: the panel and all test/screenshot launch modes are now compiled only into our local Debug builds and do not exist in this build. There are no hidden features, no remote configuration and no server; the app behaves the same for review as for customers.

Everything in the app is reachable from the 5 tabs:
1. Home: the pet. Tap to poke it, long-press or tap the chat card to chat (built-in local lines only, no AI, no network). Mini-games are opened from the pet's happiness bubble.
2. Shop: the merge-cooking game. Drag two identical items together to merge them, fill orders to earn coins and stars. A short tutorial runs for the first levels.
3. Store: food, accessories and furniture bought with in-game coins.
4. Nest: place furniture.
5. Me: settings, iCloud save status.

Time-based content (visible on the date, nothing is unlocked remotely): weekend events every Saturday-Sunday; seasonal events Oct 24-Nov 2 and Dec 18-31; a 30-day season pass track that resets each season; some accessories are only on sale during a holiday window (shown with their dates in the Store).

In-app purchases (consumable, Shop tab > gem icon at the top): Starter Pack (one time), 80 / 220 / 480 / 1000 gems. Gems speed things up, buy energy and bag slots; everything can also be earned by playing.

Game Center: optional weekly leaderboard for orders served (sign-in only when the user taps the leaderboard card).
iCloud: game progress is backed up to iCloud key-value storage so it can be restored on a new device.

Permissions (all optional, the app works without them):
- Health (read only): today's steps and workouts, shown as the pet's activity.
- Motion & Fitness: walking/running/driving changes the pet's pose in the Dynamic Island.
- Camera (front): "eye contact" feature while the app is open, on device only, nothing is recorded or stored.
- Notifications: reminders when the pet is hungry or an order is ready.
